trap.label: deve ter + particípio
trap.wrong: She must to have forgotten the meeting.
trap.right: She must have forgotten the meeting.
trap.why: Em português, "deve ter esquecido" tem a preposição-ligação implícita; o aluno copia com to. Em inglês é must have + particípio.

mcq.q: A dedução negativa de "She was there" é...

opts: We could have gone by train.
mcq.why: could have + particípio = poderíamos ter ido (mas não fomos).

mcq.q: Complete: **The fact ___** prices rose worried everyone.

fix.wrong: He may has lost his wallet.
fix.right: He may have lost his wallet.
They are likely to arrive late.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com could have: “We can take a taxi.” (oportunidade perdida)
rewrite.answer: We could have taken a taxi.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com unlikely: “She probably won't come.”
Reescreva com that: “I have no evidence of his guilt.”
rewrite.answer: I have no evidence that he is guilty.
